technologies.name: Autonomous counterbalance truck
technologies.description: Moves and lifts loads without support legs, including dock or trailer interfaces, with residual capacity, attachment, gradient, turning and indoor/outdoor boundaries assessed for the exact configuration.

technologies.name: Autonomous reach truck
technologies.description: Stores and retrieves pallets at height using a reach mechanism, with residual capacity, mast and rack geometry, floor flatness and placement accuracy assessed together.

technologies.name: Autonomous tow tractor and tugger train
technologies.description: Moves trains of compatible trailers on repeat routes, with gross train mass, coupling, stop pattern, swept path, gradient and load securement treated as system constraints.

technologies.name: Autonomous very-narrow-aisle truck
technologies.description: Stores and retrieves loads in guided or free-navigating very-narrow aisles, with aisle guidance, floor, rack clearance, transfer aisle and load-sway limits made explicit.
